contour.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game particle feather, isolated RGBA sprite with genuinely transparent background. Match a softly hand-painted stylized dodo concept: loose plush layered vanes and subtle natural barb filaments, gentle organic imperfections, rounded forms. This is the neutral dyeable BASE COLOR texture only, so every feather pixel is neutral LIGHT GRAY, near silver/ivory but absolutely NO warm or cool hue. Subtle tonal detail around RGB 205–245, not dark grey. Broad evenly illuminated face, minimum baked shading, no directional lighting or cast shadow. Individual fine barbs are visible but softly painted, not engraved lines or glossy hair. Most of the vane is fully solid opaque; only individual barb tips, small organic edge splits, and down fringes have coverage transparency. No outline, no gray halo, no background, no border, no text, no checkerboard painted into image, no ground. Center a SINGLE feather vertically with its rounded tip at the TOP and visibly tapered quill end at the BOTTOM. Square 1024x1024 frame. Visible feather occupies about 86% of height (y=72 to 952); generous transparent margin on every edge. Direct flat front view, entire feather visible, graceful almost vertical rachis, face-on so works printed on both sides of a flat card. No perspective scene or multiple feathers.
Subject: CONTOUR feather from the dodo's back. One rounded, broad oval upper vane, not lance-shaped, about 400 pixels wide and 880 tall including quill; gently drooping soft barbs curved toward its round crown, a subtle central shaft, and the entire lower third of the vane becoming soft wispy plumules. The bottom has a short clean visible quill about 90 pixels long. Slight natural left/right irregularity. Plush and broad like the overlapping blue-grey body feathers in a stylized dodo concept, but painted entirely light neutral gray here. NO stripe or band in this neutral base — its cream tip marking will be applied by a separate region mask. The silhouette must unmistakably read as one feather at 32 pixels.

Mostly fluff, not a regular long closed vane. The tuft is made of curved fine soft branching feather barbules, organized as one feather around a subtle very short central shaft, with coherent central opaque mass and airy natural separated tips. revision.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this one neutral-gray feather sprite into a genuine small PLUMULOUS DOWN TUFT from the plush hood of a softly stylized dodo. Preserve the hand-painted soft light neutral gray color, genuine transparent background and overall vertical orientation quill down. MAJOR SHAPE CHANGE: remove the long closed oval vane, remove the long central shaft that runs to the top. Replace it with a loosely branching short triangular/ovoid puff: a tiny subtle shaft only in the lower quarter, SHORT exposed quill at bottom, ~10 gently outward-curving primary down barbs radiating upward and outward from that lower shaft, each with very fine soft secondary barbules. Little air gaps between some loose branches especially near the edges, rounded irregular fluffy crown, mostly dense opaque soft central fluff so it still reads at 32px. This should look substantially fluffier and looser than a regular feather and clearly one feather tuft, not a leaf, furball, cotton ball, tree, dandelion, or regular long stiff vane. Keep one whole centered tuft filling ~84% of square height, generous >7% transparent margins all around. Broad tuft ~650px wide, ~850 tall including short quill. Even illumination, no hard directional light, cast shadow, black outline, no text. Gray values primarily 205–245, absolutely NO color.
